confirmedRendererOwnedControlDifferences.finding: Original P displays a 15px ShieldAlert and dedicated icon column in amber attention box. Every actual A box has zero icons and text starts at ordinary12px padding. This is a manager-owned JSX/layout difference, not a missing Native pixel issue.
confirmedRendererOwnedControlDifferences.source: Frozen055 BrowserPanels.jsx:140; browser.css:181–182 display:flex/gap10/icon style. App profile-site-states.tsx:26 omits icon and inner wrapper; workspace.css:122 is block attention.

confirmedRendererOwnedControlDifferences.finding: Original P retry/clear/confirmation controls sit in an inner bw-row-actions flex-wrap container with6px gap. Actual A renders bare adjacent buttons and a block warning paragraph. Actual wide buttons touch and warning sits below retry; narrow button rows can touch vertically. P gap/flow is visibly different.
confirmedRendererOwnedControlDifferences.source: Frozen055 BrowserPanels.jsx:141–143 and browser.css:158; actual profile-site-states.tsx:26 has no inner bw-row-actions. Generic actual row-actions gap8 also differs from P6, recorded as shared source fact rather than waiving visible recovery gap0.

confirmedRendererOwnedControlDifferences.finding: P confirmation is red text/red border; actual A is ordinary text/border in both themes.
confirmedRendererOwnedControlDifferences.source: P BrowserPanels.jsx:142 adds bw-mini-danger, CSS82 #c0392b/#e6b0aa. Actual profile-site-states.tsx:26 confirm button className bw-mini only.

confirmedRendererOwnedControlDifferences.finding: Actual light warning is rgb(112,112,112), P warning red. Dark A warning remains rgb(239,143,132), matching intended dark red.
confirmedRendererOwnedControlDifferences.source: App warning uses p.bw-danger-text; workspace.css:123 .bw-attention p specificity overrides simple .bw-danger-text color at56 in light. .ydark .bw-danger-text wins in dark. Original P uses span.bw-danger-text (BrowserPanels.jsx:142), avoiding paragraph override.

copyAndBusinessDifferencesPendingCoordin.finding: All16 actual alert explanations omit the original P Agent-browser-command/BROWSER_UNAVAILABLE clause and use different phrasing; failed-state clear button says 清空登录态 versus P 清空该登录态. This is a definite textual mismatch, not fixture URL/name data. Whether the current approved business copy permits it is not established by this scoped review. Shorter copy plus missing icon/action layout substantially changes card/dialog heights; those deltas cannot all be dismissed as shell4px.

P prototype leaves 克隆 enabled in needs-attention; actual A disables it, consistently with actual renderer source guard importState!==ready. Do not enable a blocked operation merely to fit prototype. Root must reconcile current requirement/prototype applicability.

faultInjectionBoundary.setup: Owned BrowserService public constructor receives synthetic Chrome source DB/key provider/private AESGCM journal cipher. Existing process-local mock-keychain and MailWorker debugger-inheritance fixture explicit. Daily data/default credentials/system truststore untouched.
faultInjectionBoundary.effect: Exact current own profile NativeStore performs actual W write then loses acknowledgement; restoring original X throws before native write. Real production transaction creates needs-attention, encrypted journal and suspended blank page; no Hoststore/importState/RPC result synthesis. All eight actual13-event fault slices exhibit both effects.
faultInjectionBoundary.testedUI: Actual UI source/target/risk confirmation triggers import, actual manager and clear-confirm state captured; then fault mode none and actual UI confirm-clear returns ready and removes journal.
faultInjectionBoundary.limits: These results certify visual recovery controls in an explicitly altered fault environment. They do not establish real Keychain/Chrome import, unmodified environment or full T081 pass.

separateBoundaries: All manager controls are renderer-owned and visible; confirmed icon/color/button/flow differences are directly supported by actual PNG+metadata/frozen JSX/CSS.

Live Native page/background compositor pixels and full system screenshot parity are not certified by main-renderer PNG. Prototype synthetic page and recovery banner differ from actual blocked-page presentation; this review does not turn that backdrop into a separate confirmed compositor defect.
Original P profile label has WillYou prefix, actual service label 项目登录态; isolated task/sidebar/terminal/count/URL/title and absent prototype demo rows are fixture data differences.
P/A underlying pane/shell origin differs4px and actual bottom statusbar allocation differs. Dialog height changes also follow actual content/layout differences; no blanket geometry waiver.
No scrolling or new focus/OS interaction occurred in review. Narrow1440 clear-confirm lower content is scrollable; only originally visible controls were visually reviewed.
